title: AgentDoc Stage-Bound Proof Obligation
description: Typed, stateful, stage-bound proof obligation record (KNOWLEDGE-MODEL K8, D16), bound to the exact managed content version it constrains. Obligation states and required_at stages are registered closed vocabularies (CONTRACT-REGISTRY.md). Whether an obligation is informational or blocking at a stage/risk/action is classification-policy data (see $defs/classificationPolicy), never code. The root object is the obligation record alone; $defs/waiver and $defs/classificationPolicy are envelope-governed named subschemas the record never embeds - their carrier is the obligation ledger's event stream and the consumer-side store rows replaying it (validated by $ref against these $defs; the enclosing audit envelope is registered when the E1.4/E4.2 enclosure lands). Consequently a record whose state is 'waived' is interpretable only alongside its binding waiver: the record carries no expiry, so a consumer must evaluate the waiver's expires_after against the current event ordinal before treating the obligation as discharged - an expired waiver reopens it as blocking. The stateless ProofObligation shape embedded in adoc.review.v0/adoc.patch.check.v0 is a separate, unchanged contract. No wall-clock exists anywhere in these records: time-bounds evaluate against an explicit event-ordinal input.

risk.description: The producer's risk classification of the constrained change, matched against risk-scoped policy rules. Data, never authority.

subject.description: The exact immutable content version the obligation constrains: workspace canonical identity plus managed version ID (E1.4) — never a bare Object ID.

classificationPolicy.description: The K8 classification policy: informational vs blocking per stage/risk/action is data carried here. First matching rule wins; default_classification applies when none match. Not a record property: carried beside the records by the ledger/consumer store and validated by $ref against this subschema.

classificationRule.description: One rule. risk and action are optional exact matchers - absent means any.

waiver.description: An Obligation Waiver (K8): permission-controlled discharge of one obligation, bound to the exact obligation + workspace-qualified managed-version subject + principal + policy version, justified, and time-bounded where appropriate by an explicit event-ordinal expiry (no wall-clock). Managed version IDs are workspace-minted (mv-N recurs in every workspace), so the subject is the binding - never a bare version ID. A waiver changes obligation state only - it never converts unverified to verified, and an expired waiver reopens its obligation as blocking. Not a record property: carried as a ledger event beside its record, and required context for interpreting a record whose state is 'waived' (see the root description).

expires_after.description: The last E1.4 event ordinal the waiver holds at; evaluated against an explicit ordinal input. Absent: not time-bounded.
